claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol; paper: iTregs from four cord-blood donors.

claims.value: Cord blood naive CD4+ T cells with TGFb, IL2, ATRA and serum for 72 h, sorted by CD103; the comparison is carried by enrichment process / factor value[enrichment process].
Orbitrap Fusion Lumos FAIMS DIA 395-1005 m/z, NCE 28; Trypsin; DTT/IAA; Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M and N-term Acetyl variable.

limitations: Run names contain 'Pool'; whether each replicate pools donors is not stated: pooled sample, age, sex `not available`.
Dissociation method is not stated (only NCE 28): `not available`. Mass tolerances and DIA windows not stated.
Treatment concentrations (TGFb 10 ng/ml, IL-2 12 ng/ml, ATRA 10 nM, serum 10%) are in the paper but the treatment cell is one free-text summary.
